descripcion: Photographs of the El Tintal Public Library Manuel Zapata Olivella, located in Bogotá, Colombia. The building was constructed on the remaining structures of a former recycling plant from the El Tintal landfill and is now one of the city's main cultural facilities. The images show the exterior architecture, the large public areas, surrounding green spaces, and various structural and urban design details.
